# [TASK] Automated live-stack API smoke test (newman) — shared script + CI job

## Task
Automate the Postman/newman collection that exercises the running stack end-to-end, so live-service acceptance runs without anyone clicking through Postman by hand — both locally and in CI.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [x] `infrastructure/docker/smoke-test.sh` waits for the gateway + downstream services to report healthy (bounded timeout, not a fixed sleep), then runs newman with CLI + JUnit reporters, exiting non-zero on any failed request/assertion
- [x] `MANAGE_STACK=true` mode brings the compose stack up first and tears it down after, dumping container logs on failure; detects `docker compose` vs `podman-compose` automatically
- [x] Script is parameterized by env (`GATEWAY_URL`, `COLLECTION`, `TMDB_API_KEY`, `HEALTH_TIMEOUT`, plus optional TMDB account credentials for the authenticated flow)
- [x] `.github/workflows/e2e-smoke.yml` runs the script with `MANAGE_STACK=true` on `workflow_dispatch` + nightly schedule (not per-push, to keep CI minutes and the $0 budget low) and uploads the newman JUnit report as an artifact
- [x] Required `TMDB_API_KEY` repo secret and local usage documented in the script header and workflow comments

## Estimate
**Hours:** 6

## Notes
Closed previously with the acceptance-criteria boxes left unchecked even though the implementation (commit `0d1b623`) was complete — corrected in this sync. Both `smoke-test.sh` and `e2e-smoke.yml` were re-verified against the current repo and match every item above.
